description: An older Makosso-Warra Shipworks vessel class, originally built for N+S supply operations, though quickly abandoned for its relatively low cargo capacity. The design has instead found its place in the Vigilitas Crisis Response fleet where it played the role of a rapid deployment platform for personnel, armored vehicles and heavy equipment - the duty it retains to this day. Besras became most notable during the ICW, where they would be the primary line of defense for the Warra colonies - both against external threats and internal fires.
